message.content: The paper 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks' by Patrick Lewis et al. (2020) introduces a method called Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for improving the performance of language models on knowledge-intensive tasks. The approach combines the strengths of retrieval-based and generation-based models by using a retriever to fetch relevant documents and a generator to produce answers based on the retrieved information. This method aims to enhance the accuracy and reliability of language models in tasks that require access to external knowledge sources. The authors demonstrate the effectiveness of RAG through experiments on various NLP tasks, showing significant improvements over baseline models.
